scientific_integrity: Exact finite exhaustive theorem, supported by two independently structured complete enumerations and explicit adjacency and isomorphism certificates. No independent external scientific audit or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the eighteen-vertex Pappus incidence graph. All pairwise distances asserted are between maximum induced matchings in the reserve-three graph, not the diameter of all its states. A relevant 2013 complexity paper could not be inspected in full; residual unindexed overlap is possible.
title: A sharp two-edge reserve for induced-matching reconfiguration in the Pappus graph
